engine_notes: Quality subrubrics are source-defined at their stated maxima; historical partial scores are preserved from the fallo and remain manually editable.
Human-resources experience is modeled proportionally because the criterion describes proportional scoring relative to the maximum years accredited.
Academic preparation is parameterized in the application to support prequalification; review the final scoring interpretation against the active convocatoria/junta before bid submission.
Contract-compliance helper uses an internal 1-point-per-compliant-reference up to 3 for planning; manual override is available because the source describes proportional comparison among bidders.
